text:
## Policy Statement  
**FirstUK Bank requires that all customers be positively identified and verified before account opening or product provision.**
name: Chunk 5/28

raw_entities.name: Customer Identification and Verification Policy
raw_entities.description: FirstUK Bank's foundational policy requiring positive identification and verification of all customers prior to account opening or product provision. This policy establishes the bank's mandatory stance on customer due diligence at the point of relationship initiation.
context: FirstUK Bank requires that all customers be positively identified and verified before account opening or product provision.

raw_entities.name: Mandatory Positive Customer Identification Before Account Opening
raw_entities.description: A binding requirement that all customers must be positively identified prior to account opening. This provision establishes the operational gate that must be satisfied before any account can be established.
context: all customers be positively identified and verified before account opening or product provision

raw_entities.name: Mandatory Customer Verification Before Product Provision
raw_entities.description: A binding requirement that all customers must be verified prior to the provision of any banking product. This provision ensures compliance with due diligence obligations at the point of product delivery.
context: all customers be positively identified and verified before account opening or product provision

raw_entities.name: Customer Identity Verification
raw_entities.description: The process of positively identifying customers as mandated by FirstUK Bank policy. This verification must be completed before account opening or product provision can proceed.
context: all customers be positively identified and verified before account opening or product provision

raw_entities.name: Customer
raw_entities.description: Any natural person seeking to open an account or receive a banking product from FirstUK Bank, subject to mandatory identification and verification requirements prior to relationship initiation.
context: all customers be positively identified and verified before account opening or product provision

raw_entities.name: Account
raw_entities.description: A banking account to be opened by a customer, which cannot be established until the customer has been positively identified and verified in accordance with policy requirements.
context: before account opening or product provision

raw_entities.name: Banking Product
raw_entities.description: Any banking product offered by FirstUK Bank that cannot be provided to a customer until positive identification and verification have been completed.
context: before account opening or product provision
